name: PREDATOR'S SICKNESS
source:
Following the exploits of two men - Penn and Veryl, promoter and booker respectively of an underground wrestling promotion. But not today as Penn intends to have a normal evening with his best pal and partner in crime. Things take a turn when Veryl's appetite needs to be satiated.
